cohort: Pregnant women in the UK with a previous cesarean section between 2005 and 2012
finding: No significant difference was found in the rates of severe maternal morbidities between women who had a planned VBAC and those who underwent ERCS.
mod_finding: This study compared maternal risks associated with planned vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC) and elective repeat cesarean section (ERCS) but did not find significant differences in the rates of severe maternal morbidities between the two groups.
